test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To read between the lines
solution: The correct answer is **'To understand the implied meaning'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • To read between the lines is an idiom that means to understand what someone really means, or what is really happening in a situation, even though it is not said openly. (यह समझने के लिए कि किसी का वास्तव में क्या मतलब है, या किसी स्थिति में वास्तव में क्या हो रहा है, भले ही यह खुले तौर पर न कहा गया हो) • Example -* They say that everything's fine, but **reading between the lines** I suspect they have some marital problems.* • So, to understand the implied meaning is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 9f:T606, ​The correct answer is** 'Let her be given a 50% raise in salary.'**
